name: Colorful Terminals
author: Andrei Yurik
description: Give every project its own terminal color, so you always know where you are. Super+Ctrl+Alt+1…9 opens a project or jumps to its open window, and Super+Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1…8 gives any terminal a color of its own. Works with any project launcher.

barWidget.description: Opens the Colorful Terminals panel: project colors and hotkeys
